Paragraph: "On seeing them, the wielders of best weapons and audacious ones, the two brothers and great souls, namely Rama and Lakshmana, Sugreeva became ambiguous..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Sugreeva spots two formidable armed warriors approaching his hideout and feels intense apprehension and suspicion.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva observes the incoming figures and remains hyper-vigilant, doubting their true intentions.
Outcome/Resolution: He enters a state of emotional ambiguity and threat-alert due to past trauma.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Relationship Challenges (Family): Threat Perception, Paranoia from Past Betrayal

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Shanka (Suspicion and anxiety born out of fear and past betrayal)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The soul in fear (Sugreeva) initially views the approaching Divine (Rama) through the lens of suspicion and doubt rather than trust.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Hyper-vigilance and threat-monitoring: evaluating strangers as potential threats when living under chronic fear and persecution.
